Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one production-oriented protagonist turnaround concept sheet for the Chinese shop-management game PCShop. This is a proposed achievable character art target. Integrate these into ONE consistent protagonist, do not copy other characters.
Landscape sheet, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio, light neutral gray background. Short unobtrusive Chinese title at top left “主角 · 建模目标草案”. Main upper 72 percent consists of four full-body views, all SAME height, proportions, face, clothes and neutral relaxed standing pose, feet on same baseline: straight front, front three-quarter, true side, true back. Chinese labels below them “正面”, “斜前”, “侧面”, “背面”. Lower 24 percent shows the SAME model as three small isolated figures viewed from a game camera at 40–45 degree downward pitch, front three-quarter, side, back three-quarter, under one shared label “俯视小尺寸示意”. All small figures must genuinely be scaled smaller with simpler readable detail. Keep empty space around them, no environments, no decorative color chips, no callout arrows, no tools.
Young adult Chinese male modest shopkeeper, about 3.8 heads tall, slightly oversized head with a substantial torso and comfortably long enough legs, young adult rather than baby. Simple softly squared cheeks, small oval dark eyes without drawn white sclera or complex iris, restrained eyebrows, tiny rounded modeled nose, single short closed smile. Small ears nestled into the side of head, limited protrusion, single smooth cheek silhouette. Dark nearly black hair formed from one shaped crown plus 5–7 broad asymmetrical pointed locks, simple continuous masses, back of skull has rounded volume. No fine strands or carved grooves.
Hip-length open olive-brown jacket, cream collarless shallow V-neck undershirt, dark navy straight long trousers, plain brown ankle-low work shoes with a visible sole. Jacket has a broad flat fold-over collar, two very simple patch pockets, slightly fuller upper sleeves then plain cuffs, one or two broad bend folds only at elbows and knees. Open jacket sides have visible minimal thickness. Trousers stop naturally at shoes. Hands rounded but clearly have a thumb and one grouped finger volume. Shoulder width and modest body posture should look like the left man in reference 2.
Rendering MUST stay in a very achievable smooth low-to-mid-poly Unity game asset vocabulary, roughly the form complexity of the actual reference 1 lower row. Matte painted base colors, clean two-tone cel shadows in cool brown-purple, extremely subtle sparse pigment variation, consistent delicate dark-brown contours. Maintain modest genuine 3D volume in cheek, head, sleeves, shoes with two shadow bands. Neutral white-balanced simple directional light from upper left, soft minimal contact shadow under feet. Outfit base colors approximately jacket #7C623A, shirt #E2D6B8, pants #384260, shoes #54402F.
No fabric weave, denim grain, stitching, knit, detailed shoe laces, pores, soft waxy skin, photorealism, plush material, collectible doll shading, detailed facial muscles, complex anatomy, volumetric bounce glow, bloom, metallic reflections. No flat polygon facets, no cuboid limbs, no rigid cylinder-shaped hair, no photobashed texture, no frontal portrait painted onto side face. Shadows coherent with rotation. Absolutely no extra detail that would make this promise an expensive sculpt or cinematic render. Avoid the polished character model-sheet aesthetic. The goal is an attractive cohesive small game character that an existing simple sculpted Unity character pipeline could reasonably approximate through a few shape and shading changes.
